provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code over Z_341: H_X=[circ(a)|circ(b)], H_Z=[circ(b)^T|circ(a)^T], with a={33,55,100,131,133,143,154,164,181,220,330,336} (weight 12, invariant under j->32j mod 341: fixed points 33,55,143,154,220,330 and pair-orbits {100,131},{133,164},{181,336}) and b=a(x^4)={4j mod 341 : j in a}={42,59,132,183,191,198,220,231,275,297,315,321}, a Frobenius image with the same zero set. Shared divisor (x+1) * one quintic * six full-order decics of x^341-1 (degree 66), so k=132; both check weights 12 (w=24). Found by sampling symmetric weight-11/12/13 words (method in the note) with exact GF(1024) zero sets, screened by the constituent-code cap and a 1k->2M RIS ladder, then 10,000,000 fresh-seed accelerated RIS trials (lightest logical: weight 87); the CI gate's 8M-trial pass then found a weight-84 X logical, recorded as the X witness.

search_budget.tool: symmetric-word sampler with GF(1024) zero sets + gf2_fast accelerator
